Change only already-eligible bypass face membership and search their positions using the existing bounded named-pad constructor. All owners, shared bulk and unrelated member poses remain fixed relative to the selected seed. The potentially overlapping seed is never published. Import executed work before independent mechanical/identity screening and deduplication. Preserve all previous alternatives.

owner/bulk/unrelated position, rotation, face and mirror invariance

screen.reference_comparison: All five board_aux projected pad gaps improve against preserved f7ad4f reference; C7001 unchanged. Bulk gap 6.57761 -> 3.390549146 mm. Against previous square coherent candidate, C1001 worsens (3.30697 -> 5.013198), so this does not dominate every alternative.
screen.hardware_proximity_status: UNVERIFIED; no reviewed numeric maximum or routed loop measurement

qualification.retry_tradeoff: 12 executed reseats versus 10 in prior square coherent/reference runs; below unchanged ceiling 18. No event hidden or baseline raised.
qualification.render_observations: board_aux moves as a whole to the upper-left of the top view with its owners and bypass capacitors on top; bulk and resistors are visible in the corresponding upper-right bottom view. Central module reservation and edge access remain visually consistent. Bottom remains sparse. Visual inspection does not establish access, assembly or electrical suitability.

limitations: Opt-in top-primary constructor only; bottom-primary mirrored fixed-owner construction is not implemented.
Fixed relationship means fixed relative to each seed, not identical placement across the complete board or to a different reference seed.
No board-area reduction over the 168x159 reference.
No fresh full devkit qualification or matched historical Python comparison in this batch.
Hardware assembly/access/height/thermal/proximity unknowns remain; routing out of scope; not fabrication ready.
